```yaml
name: E2E UI Tests (Kind)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - '**.md'
      - 'playwright/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - 'Dockerfile'
      - 'requirements.txt'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'uv.toml'

jobs:
  e2e-kind:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python with uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          activate-environment: 'playwright'
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Create kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@v1.14.0
        with:
          cluster_name: kind-e2e
          wait: 60

      - name: Deploy application
        run: |
          # Deploy the application using Helm (adjust chart path as needed)
          helm upgrade --install kagenti ./charts/kagenti \
            --namespace kagenti --create-namespace
          # Wait for deployment to be ready
          kubectl wait --for=condition=available --timeout=120s deployment/kagenti
          kubectl wait --for=condition=ready --timeout=120s pod -l app=kagenti

      - name: Port-forward services
        run: |
          # Forward backend and frontend services to localhost
          kubectl port-forward svc/kagenti-backend 8080:80 &
          kubectl port-forward svc/kagenti-frontend 3000:80 &
          # Give port-forward processes time to start
          sleep 10

      - name: Run Playwright UI tests
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
          KEYCLOAK_URL: http://localhost:8080
          KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID: kagenti
          KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        run: |
          uvx playwright test --reporter=junit

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report

      - name: Upload JUnit report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: junit-report
          path: junit.xml

      - name: Test Reporter
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: Playwright Tests
          path: junit.xml
          reporter: java-junit
          fail-on-error: true

      - name: JUnit PR Check
        uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          report_paths: junit.xml
          check_name: Playwright E2E Tests
          fail_on_failure: true
```
